HOT PLATE WELDING INFRARED WELDING VIBRATION WELDING LASER WELDING TURN2WELD ULTRASONIC WELDING Read More High tech with a human touch This is how we see ourselves. And even more importantly: This is how our customers perceive us. Worldwide, our committed colleagues contribute their expertise to making production more economical. By designing customised machines and systems for plastic joining. And, above all: Comprehensive, individual consulting accompanying all projects. MEDICAL MORE New possibilities The acquisition of bielomatik by Persico Group opens up a wealth of new possibilities for the Medical Customers. Thanks to our experience and our high quality solutions, we are your supplier for plastic welding and medical bag equipment – worldwide! By combining the Know-How of the design of parts, tools and machines with state-of-the-art technology - made in Germany,we can supply to the global medical market: • Prototypes and developments • Medical and Bio medical bag lines • Radio Frequency welding • Thermal welding • Impulse welding • Laser welding • Hot plate welding Be amazed! We think in solutions – outside the box! www.persico.com Bielomatik is TISAX Certified We are pleased to announce that Bielomatik has successfully achieved TISAX certification and is now listed in the ENX portal (https://portal.enx.com/en-US/). This certification demonstrates our commitment to the highest standards of information security, ensuring that our customers and partners can rely on a secure and trusted environment. What is TISAX? TISAX (Trusted Information Security Assessment Exchange) is a recognized assessment and exchange framework designed to enhance information security across industries. By achieving TISAX certification, Bielomatik ensures compliance with strict security requirements, facilitating seamless collaboration with other TISAX-certified companies. For more details about our TISAX certification or to discuss how we uphold the highest security standards, feel free to contact us.
